results.name: label-create-is-atomic
results.note: ADOPTED: label name uniqueness holds under parallel create => valid lease/fence primitive (issues:write only).

results.name: milestone-create-is-atomic
results.note: EXPECTED FAIL / REJECTED: title uniqueness is a validation, not an atomic constraint; parallel creators all succeed. Must not be used as a lock.

results.name: git-ref-advance-is-compare-and-swap (needs contents:write; fallback only)
results.note: Non-force ref update behaves as CAS on a commit chain, but requires contents:write.

results.name: actions-variable-create-is-atomic (needs Variables permission; rejected for the posting identity)
results.note: Atomic, but the posting identity must not hold variable-write authority.

results.name: list-after-create-visibility
results.note: Informational: if >0 the first list can miss a just-created label; safety must rest on atomic create + fence re-check, never on one list read.

results.name: comment-ids-total-order
results.note: Server assigns unique increasing ids; list order by id is the inbox total order.

results.name: comment-patch-has-compare-and-swap
results.note: Expected FAIL (no CAS): confirms a comment revision/etag cannot be the serialization proof. (If the header is ignored the stale write succeeds.)

results.name: edit-detectable
results.note: Edited intents are detectable (updated_at != created_at) and quarantined.

results.name: label-events-attribute-actor
results.note: Issue events record the acting identity; stop/resume authority can be derived from authorized actors only.
